items.face: round cheeks, wide-set eyes, permanent half-smile
items.hair: short mop with a cowlick that never lies down

gait.description: bouncy, heels flicking high behind

items.posture: upright to the point of leaning back slightly
items.expression_neutral: looking at everything except the finish line

items.face: narrow chin, gap in the front teeth, eyebrows always up
items.hair: two high braids that swing out of phase with the stride

gait.description: very quick and very short, leans from the ankles

items.posture: forward lean well ahead of the hips
items.expression_neutral: bouncing on the spot before the gun

items.finish_motion: runs straight through the line without slowing and turns around confused

items.face: sharp jaw not grown into yet, freckles across the nose
items.hair: grown-out undercut pushed back with a headband

gait.description: over-strides slightly, all forefoot

items.posture: shoulders a touch high, tension in the neck
items.expression_neutral: jaw set, refusing to look at anyone
items.expression_effort: shoulders climb toward the ears, hands ball into fists
items.finish_motion: a hard dip at the line whether it is close or not

items.face: long features, heavy-lidded, unreadable
items.hair: chin-length and tucked behind one ear

gait.description: long and quiet, almost no vertical movement

items.posture: very tall through the spine, arms low
items.expression_neutral: still in a way that reads as either calm or nerves
items.expression_effort: nothing changes above the waist, which is its own tell
items.finish_motion: holds form through the line and keeps running past it

items.face: open, high cheekbones, smiles under load
items.hair: high ponytail cut short enough to stay put

gait.description: even and economical, textbook midfoot

items.posture: square shoulders, elbows tight
items.expression_neutral: scanning the field and counting
items.expression_effort: breathing goes audible before anything else moves
items.finish_motion: accelerates from 200 m out and does not look back

items.face: heavy brow, wide nose, deliberate blink
items.hair: close-cropped with a hard part

gait.description: heavy, audible footfall, drives from the hips

items.posture: chest open, arms carried wide of the body
items.expression_neutral: plants both feet and does not fidget
items.expression_effort: the footfall gets louder rather than the cadence slower
items.finish_motion: lowers the head and grinds the last 400 m at one pace

items.face: long neck, calm mouth, eyes fixed far ahead
items.hair: locs gathered high and wrapped

gait.description: enormous stride at a low turnover, floats between contacts

items.posture: slight forward tilt from the whole body, not the waist
items.expression_neutral: unhurried, arrives at the line last on purpose
items.expression_effort: stride shortens before cadence drops
items.finish_motion: one long change of gear rather than a sprint

items.face: hollow cheeks, quick eyes, mouth usually moving
items.hair: shaved at the sides, longer and messy on top

gait.description: restless, changes rhythm every few hundred metres

items.posture: never quite settled, one shoulder lower
items.expression_neutral: cannot stand still, walks small circles
items.expression_effort: the rhythm changes stop and it becomes one flat drive
items.finish_motion: goes early, twice, and the second one sticks

items.face: square, deep-set eyes, rarely changes
items.hair: flat top, edged sharp

gait.description: powerful and compact, very little ground contact

items.posture: absolutely vertical, arms pistoning at ninety degrees
items.expression_neutral: takes the inside lane and stands there
items.expression_effort: form does not break; the pace simply stops rising
items.finish_motion: a real sprint, upright, arms driving through

items.face: broad smile, laugh lines already starting
items.hair: short natural curls, no covering

gait.description: blade recoil on the right sets the rhythm for both sides

items.posture: tall, slight lead with the left shoulder
items.expression_neutral: checks the blade socket twice and forgets about it

items.finish_motion: the last 100 m are the fastest 100 m, every time

items.face: round, glasses that get taped before a race, patient
items.hair: thinning and honest about it

gait.description: short, metronomic, does not vary by a step

items.posture: slight forward hunch, hands low
items.expression_neutral: checks a paper split card in a pocket
items.expression_effort: nothing visible changes for a very long time
items.finish_motion: crosses at exactly the pace planned, to the second

items.face: warm, round, direct gaze, smiles at strangers
items.hair: braided crown pinned close

gait.description: grounded and rolling, strong arm carriage

items.posture: upright with the weight well back over the heels
items.expression_neutral: talking to whoever is next to her on the line
items.expression_effort: the arms take over and the legs follow them
items.finish_motion: holds the pace to the line and then hugs someone

items.face: angular, alert, one raised eyebrow at rest
items.hair: grown out to the shoulder and tied back flat

gait.description: clipped and precise, lands under the hip every time

items.posture: level shoulders, chin tucked
items.expression_neutral: watching the clock rather than the field
items.expression_effort: cadence holds and stride quietly shortens
items.finish_motion: a measured lift over the last 600 m, no sprint

items.face: weathered, thick beard, unbothered
items.hair: tied back under a folded bandana

items.face: fine features, downturned eyes, very still
items.hair: straight to the waist, wound into a low knot

gait.description: long and low with a pronounced hip drive

items.posture: a slight sway through the torso that never becomes a wobble
items.expression_neutral: stretches one calf and stops paying attention
items.expression_effort: the sway grows and the head starts to drop

items.face: deep smile lines, grey at the temples, quick to laugh
items.hair: short and neat, receding at the corners

gait.description: small fast steps, very low to the ground

items.posture: compact, elbows tucked in tight
items.expression_neutral: jokes with the person behind him until the gun

items.face: full cheeks, reading glasses on a cord, entirely unhurried

gait.description: even and rolling, absolutely unchanged from km 1 to km 30

items.posture: square and settled, arms low and relaxed
items.expression_neutral: knows the course and says so

items.face: heavy features, permanent scowl that means nothing
items.hair: shaved to the skin

gait.description: strong and slightly heavy, visible power off the toe

items.posture: chest forward, shoulders rolled back

items.face: fine lines everywhere, bright eyes, entirely present
items.hair: white bob held with a plain clip

gait.description: short and light with surprisingly quick turnover

items.posture: upright, chin level, arms compact
items.expression_neutral: first to the start line by ten minutes
